exports.name: createTilt3D
exports.description:
Imperative controller with a Tilt3D-shaped handle. Tilt3D only composes `transform`, so it is attached
without the exclusive-channel arbiter (smaller bundle); behaviour equals `attachEffect`.

exports.name: hoverEffects
exports.description: Every hover definition in catalogue order (H01–H11), for explicit registries.

exports.name: tilt3D
exports.description: The Tilt3D definition (`hover/tilt-3d`): one composable `transform` layer, no exclusive channel.

exports.signature: (ref: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, options?: Tilt3DOptions | undefined): void
